song: You Don't Mess Around with Jim (Jim Croce, 1972) - musical transcription for an original instrumental arrangement. Notes/chords/rhythms only; no lyrics.
source: reference/jim_croce_original.mp3 (primary). Cross-checked with jim_backing_preview.mp3 and published chord charts (chords/structure only).

conventions.pitch: Scientific pitch (C4 = middle C = MIDI 60). Vocal is written at sounding pitch (male voice, E3-D4 range).
conventions.time: 4/4, bars numbered from 1 at the first downbeat (0.14 s). songBeat = 0-based quarter-note index from bar 1 beat 1. beatInBar is 1-based (1.667 = swung 'and' of beat 1).
conventions.swing: Shuffle: the off-beat 8th sits at 2/3 of the beat (triplet swing). Positions x.67 / x.33 are triplet-grid positions.

tempo.feel: shuffle/swing, measured off-beat position 0.675 of the beat (ratio ~2.1:1 = triplet shuffle)
tempo.notatedAs: 4/4 with shuffled 8ths (published sheet music: cut time, 'moderately bright in 2', half note ~82)
tempo.stability: Live band, no click: gradual push from ~161.5 BPM (intro) to ~166 BPM (outro), ~+3%. Beat-to-beat jitter ~6 ms SD.

key.mode: E major / E blues (mixolydian with blue notes G natural and A#)
key.notes: Harmony is dominant-7th blues: E(7), A7, B7. Melody leans on G natural (blue 3rd) against G# in the chords.

form.name: intro
form.notes: Band only: drums, bass, acoustic guitars on E. No vocal.

form.name: verse1
form.notes: Vocal enters on bar 5 beat 1. Bars 13-20 = second half (A7/B7), bass mostly tacet (stop-time feel).

form.name: prechorus1
form.notes: 2 bars E; bass walk-up E-F#-G# into the chorus A7; vocal pickup into chorus in bar 22.

form.name: chorus1
form.notes: 8 bars: A7 E7 A7 E7 A7 A7 B7(walkdown) E. Title-line hook = bars 29-30.

form.name: tag1
form.notes: 1 bar E: post-chorus vocal tag hook (pickup from bar 30 beat 3).

form.name: turnaround1
form.notes: 2 bars B7, no vocal; bass B-B-B-B then B-B-C#-D# walk-up; piano B-octave stabs.

form.name: verse2
form.notes: Same 16-bar harmony as verse 1; vocal pickup at bar 33 beat 3&. Piano enters. Stop-time bars 38-39 and 42-47.

form.name: verse3
form.notes: Same harmony; bars 63-70 feature the boogie walking bass (E-E-B-B then E-G#-A-A#-B). Stop-time bars 71-76.

form.name: prechorus3
form.notes: 2 bars E, walk-up F-F#-G-G# to A7.

form.name: tag3
form.notes: Tag hook, sung higher (up to E4) the third time.

form.name: breakdown
form.notes: 8 bars E vamp: bass quarters + chromatic pickup B1-C2-D2-D#2 every 2nd bar; vocal is low, speech-like ad-lib (no fixed melody). Bar 97 carries the pickup into chorus 4.

form.name: outro
form.notes: E vamp; the tag hook repeats every 2 bars (B3 lands on bars 108,110,...,118); bass walk-ups G#-A-A#-B. Fade from ~bar 116; last beat ~bar 119 (173.3 s), audio silent by ~176 s.

chordDetails.chorusBar7_walkdown: Bass B2(1) A2(2) G2(3) F#2(4) -> E2; guitars hold B7 (or follow the walk). Treat as B7 on beat 1 with a descending bass line, not four chords.
chordDetails.prechorus_walkup: Bar 2 of each pre-chorus: bass E2(1) E2(2) F#2(3) G#2(4) -> A2 (prechorus3 uses F2 F#2 G2 G#2 chromatic).
chordDetails.verseBar8_E7: D natural added (E7) in the 8th bar of each verse to lead to A7.
chordDetails.turnaround_walkup: Bar 2 of each B7 turnaround: bass B1(1) B1(2) C#2(3) D#2(4) -> E2.

drums.confidence: high for kick/snare placement; medium for fills
drums.timekeeping: quarter-note time (few swung 8th hits detected); a two-beat shuffle 'boom-chick'.
drums.fill: At the end of most 4-bar phrases (bars 4, 8, 12, 20, 30, 32-33 ...): accent on the swung '&' of 3 (beat 3.67) then kick+snare on beat 4.

bass.confidence: high for chorus walk, walkdown, turnaround and verse-3 boogie; medium for verse pedal pickups

versePedal.desc: E2 on every quarter; every 2nd bar adds low B1 approach notes on the swung '&' of 3 and 4

verseBoogie.desc: Verse 3 bars 63-70 (2-bar figure, repeats 4x). Signature boogie climb.

chorusA7.desc: Each A7 bar in the chorus: octave drop then chromatic climb to E

chorusE7.desc: E7 bar after an A7 bar (medium confidence)

hookWalkdown.desc: Chorus bar 7 -> 8: the title-hook bass line

bass.stopTime: Second half of each verse (A7/B7 bars) the bass mostly lays out, leaving drums + guitars.

guitars.desc: Two strummed acoustic guitars, shuffle strum on open-position chords. No single-note guitar riff in the original; the 'riff identity' lives in the bass walks and the vocal hook.

piano.desc: Honky-tonk right hand: B-octave stabs (B2+B3+B4) on each beat of the B7 turnaround; short E7 fills (E4, G#4, B4, D5) and grace-note licks between vocal phrases in verses 2-3.

derivedRiffsForArrangement.note: NOT literal parts of the original: suggested hard-rock riffs built from the original's own bass/vocal material.

stompRiffE.desc: From the verse-3 boogie bass; 2 bars, double with distorted guitar an octave up

chorusClimbA.desc: A2 A1 C#2 D2 D#2 E2 as a unison band riff under the chorus A7 bars

hookWalkdownB.desc: B-A-G-F# -> E, the whole band in unison quarter-note hits on the title hook (Castle-Rock-style 'hit' moments)

turnaroundStabs.desc: B7 stabs on every beat for 2 bars + C#-D# pickup: natural jump/punch cue

chorusCanonical.desc: Hand-curated consensus of the 4 choruses (they agree closely). relBeat 0 = beat 1 of chorus bar 1. Use for every chorus.

notes.comment: slide down from G3; phrase end
tail, often dropped; HOOK B end

phrases.name: line1
phrases.desc: reciting A3/G3, rises to B3, falls to F#3

phrases.name: line2
phrases.desc: same shape as line 1, ends lower on E3

phrases.name: line4_hookA
phrases.desc: THE title-line hook: A3 B3 A3 . G3 . D3 E3 then E3, over bass B-A-G-F#-E

phrases.name: tag_hookB
phrases.desc: post-chorus tag: G3 A3 A3 then B3 A3 G3 A3 G3 G3; repeated every 2 bars in the outro

verse1.desc: Auto-transcribed from the isolated vocal (CREPE pitch + onset segmentation, snapped to E-blues/mixolydian), octave outliers and scoops cleaned. Speech-like delivery: pitches are A3/B3 reciting tones with G3 neighbours and E3 cadences. relBeat 0 = beat 1 of the verse's first bar.

verse2.desc: Auto-transcribed from the isolated vocal (CREPE pitch + onset segmentation, snapped to E-blues/mixolydian), octave outliers and scoops cleaned. Speech-like delivery: pitches are A3/B3 reciting tones with G3 neighbours and E3 cadences. relBeat 0 = beat 1 of the verse's first bar.

verse3.desc: Auto-transcribed from the isolated vocal (CREPE pitch + onset segmentation, snapped to E-blues/mixolydian), octave outliers and scoops cleaned. Speech-like delivery: pitches are A3/B3 reciting tones with G3 neighbours and E3 cadences. relBeat 0 = beat 1 of the verse's first bar.

hooks.name: Hook B - tag
hooks.where: chorus bar 8 beat 3 -> bar 9 (song bars 30-31, 59-60, 88-89, 105-106) and 6 more times in the outro (bars 107-118)

high: chord progression (audio + backing track + published charts agree)
bass walks (chorus climb, walkdown, turnaround, verse-3 boogie)
chorus melody contour and hook rhythms
medium: exact chorus pitches on quick passing notes (D#3 vs E3 in hook A)
verse melody note-by-note (speech-like, varies per verse)
low: anything in the fade after bar 116
